rationale: Official HCL Workload Automation documentation describes workload service assurance as deadline-based critical-job scheduling, predecessor-time calculations, path monitoring and automatic prioritization. Those are explicit conventional scheduling mechanics, not AI. But this is only one optional feature and not comprehensive coverage of the complete product; best-supported negative remains weak/forced.
version_scope: HCL Workload Automation documentation v10.2.7; record's milestone #8 is not a product release identifier and no product version is supplied.
issues: Evidence documents only the named optional feature, not all core/included product functions.

sources.excerpt: Workload service assurance is an optional feature that provides the means to flag jobs as mission critical ... The scheduler (batchman) acts automatically to remedy delays by prioritizing jobs that are actually or potentially putting the target deadline at risk
sources.applicability: Exact optional Workload Automation feature description; supports the identified feature's conventional operation, not full product feature set.
